notes:
Real (beacon node https://ethereum-beacon-api.publicnode.com, head state, epoch 485701): snapshot.byCredentialStatus, effectiveBalanceHistogram, queues (validator statuses + /pending_deposits, /pending_consolidations, /pending_partial_withdrawals). Credential type = first byte of withdrawal_credentials. ETH values are Gwei sums / 1e9 rounded to whole ETH.
Real (Lab API dim_node): topEntities joins dim_node.source by validator_index for active_* validators; 5345 active validators missing from dim_node (newest indices) and source 'unknown' are excluded.
pendingDeposits: newValidatorCount = distinct pubkeys not in the validator set; topUpCount = count - newValidatorCount (includes repeat deposits to a not-yet-created pubkey). pendingConsolidations: switchToCompoundingCount = entries with source_index == target_index.
Real (Lab API fct_validator_count_by_entity_by_status_daily): weeklyStatus, every 7th day from 2020-12-03 to 2026-10-29, summed across entities. pending_* -> pending, active_ongoing -> active, active_exiting/active_slashed -> exiting, exited_* -> exited, withdrawal_* -> withdrawn.
MODELLED: weeklyCredential (modelled=true on every point). The public node is not an archive node: /eth/v1/beacon/states/<slot>/... returns 403 for any numeric slot and state-root ids for older blocks return 404, so historical credential types were unavailable. Model: total count = weeklyStatus.active (active_ongoing). 0x00 share falls linearly from 70% at genesis (2020-12-01) to 55% at Capella (2023-04-12), then decays exponentially (time constant 2 months, ~78% of the drop in the first 3 months) to the snapshot share (0.0107) at Capella+12 months and stays flat. 0x02 is zero before Pectra (2025-05-07), then its count share follows a normalised logistic S-curve (midpoint at 40% of Pectra->last date) up to the snapshot share (0.0297); 0x01 is the remainder. Effective balance: 0x00 = count x 32; 0x01 = count x snapshot 0x01 average (31.999); 0x02 = count x average that follows the same S-curve from 32 to the snapshot average (773.1). The final point (2026-10-29) is replaced with the exact snapshot active_ongoing counts/effective balances per credential type, so it matches snapshot.byCredentialStatus (active_ongoing rows) rather than that day's weeklyStatus.active.
